bibleget-desc: Fetch Bible quotes from the BibleGet API using a <biblequote> tag.
bibleget-tracking-category-desc: Pages where a Bible quote could not be fetched.
bibleget-toolong-category: Pages with Bible quotes cut to the verse limit
bibleget-toolong-category-desc: Pages where a Bible quote was cut to the maximum number of verses.
bibleget-error-network: The BibleGet service could not be reached.
bibleget-error-status: The BibleGet service could not give this quote.
bibleget-error-reference: BibleGet did not recognise this reference.
bibleget-error-version: BibleGet does not know this Bible version.
bibleget-error-ratelimit: Too many Bible quotes were requested; try again later.
bibleget-error-registration: This wiki could not register with the BibleGet service.
bibleget-error-clientkey-revoked: The BibleGet service no longer accepts this version of the extension; update it or set a BibleGet project key.
bibleget-error-toomany: This page has more Bible quotes than this wiki allows on one page.
bibleget-note-cut: Only the first $1 {{PLURAL:$1|verse is|verses are}} shown.
right-bibleget-manage: Manage the BibleGet extension and receive its service notices
bibleget-notice-deprecation: The BibleGet service has announced that features this wiki uses are deprecated as of $1.
bibleget-notice-sunset: The BibleGet service has announced that features this wiki uses will stop working on $1.
echo-pref-tooltip-bibleget: Notify me when the BibleGet service sends a notice to this wiki's BibleGet managers.
